body:
Discussion with @bqqbarbhg. Is this something on godot engine or is it ufbx?
 
> Looks like a bit of both, ufbx should probably have some kind of separate "normal map strength" PBR value.
> Materials in general are a mess in FBX, it seems like pbr.normal_map.value_real is valid for Maya/Arnold/3ds materials, but for default FBX materials (such as that file, and majority of other files) NormalMap will have a value of zero
> there is a separate "bump factor" value for FBX, but I'm not sure if it's used with normal maps
> actually, looks like it's only used in 3ds Max physical material
> so I'd say just getting rid of importing it would be a good idea, since it very rarely has any reasonable value 
> if you want to support the fringe cases where it's still used then should probably check that pbr.normal_map.value_components == 1 which would fix the cases where it's (0,0,0) as it is in FBX legacy materials 
> not sure about the BumpFactor, I doubt it's used anywhere really
